meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - Common Law (modeled on U.S. corporate law) with customary law overlay; commercial law is statutory
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No bilateral investment treaty or comprehensive double taxation agreement currently in force
Amended Compact of Free Association between the U.S. and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (2003, economic provisions in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), including UBO register obligations; Money Laundering (Prevention and Control) Act 2003 (as amended); RMI Beneficial Ownership Information (Companies) Regulations 2022 (as amended); Internal Revenue Act (as amended for FATCA/CRS reporting); RMI FIU AML/CFT Directives and sanctions notices.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, UBOs, directors, and officers against: UN Security Council Consolidated List; US OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists including sectoral sanctions; EU consolidated financial sanctions; and RMI domestic restricted-persons / FIU directives. PEPs and close associates are automatically subject to enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. The financial-newswire line is low risk, but any SWIFT/SWIFT or Stripe payment rails will still require standard OFAC/AML customer verification and transaction monitoring at account level.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Business Registry e-Filing Portal administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official business-language forms are in English. Proposed names in Marshallese or any non-Latin script must be accompanied by a Latin-script transliteration. The corporate name must contain an English corporate designator (Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, or accepted abbreviation) and must be distinguishable in the registrar's index.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Fund / Mutual Fund / Collective Investment Scheme
Phoenix, Majuro, or other RMI government-affiliated terms implying official sponsorship
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered corporation in the RMI register
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection is issued in writing by the Registrar. The applicant or licensed registered agent may file an administrative appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of rejection, attaching a proposed corrected name and evidence of distinctiveness. The Registrar must render a decision within 10 business days. A further refusal may be challenged by filing a writ of judicial review in the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 21 days, through a licensed RMI attorney.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual-only arrangements are permitted only where a licensed RMI registered agent maintains the statutory registered office and physical address; a standalone virtual mailbox without a registered agent is not sufficient. For the proposed non-resident financial newswire API, no physical local presence is required, but all official correspondence must be directed through the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 2% annual probability): the entity is a non-licensed, non-resident information-services company with no captive banking activity; however, RMI AML/CFT supervisors may conduct random inspections of registered-agent records, and risk indicators could elevate the probability to medium.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (RMI BCA), codified as Title 28 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, as amended; Sections 104-106 (incorporation and filing), 108 (registered office and agent), 146 (initial directors) and 212 (filing fees and franchise tax); Business License Act 2004 governs any future domestic business presence.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll; statutory filing acceptance and corporate registry administration performed through licensed Resident Agents under the Marshall Islands Registry framework.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation executed by the Incorporator in accordance with RMI BCA Section 105, delivered to the Registrar of Corporations, and made effective by the endorsed Certificate of Incorporation under RMI BCA Section 106.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Marshall Islands Business Corporation; the BCA permits share consideration in money, property, or services with adequacy determined conclusively by the Board, and no escrow account is required for a standard Non-Resident exempt entity.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED, that the Board accepts the subscription of the Incorporator and hereby issues One (1) fully paid, non-assessable Class A Common Share in the Corporation, the sufficiency of the stated consideration being conclusively determined by this Board.

RESOLVED, that the registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands is established at the office of the licensed Registered Agent, Trust Company Complex, Ajeltake Road, Majuro, MH 96960, and the Registered Agent is appointed to accept service of process.

RESOLVED, that [DIRECTOR_ONE] is appointed President, [DIRECTOR_TWO] is appointed Secretary, and [DIRECTOR_THREE] is appointed Treasurer, each to serve until successors are duly elected.

RESOLVED, that the President is authorised to execute all documents necessary to perfect the Corporation's Non-Resident exempt status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and KYC Acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations - via a Resident Agent licensed under RMI BCA Section 108
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Registered Agent Engagement Agreement with a Registrar-listed resident agent; deliver complete corporate know-your-customer and ultimate beneficial ownership documentation; instruct the agent to open the statutory client file, verify corporate name availability at the Registry, and confirm the registered office mandate at a Majuro or Ebeye address. The agent will thereafter file all registry submissions as the statutory transmission channel.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Engagement Agreement
Ultimate Beneficial Ownership declaration and corporate due diligence questionnaire
Certified passport copies of the Incorporator and the initial directors
Bank reference or professional standing letter of the beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should the Resident Agent issue a KYC query, file supplemental evidence (bank reference, legalised passport, or an independent director attestation); where the principal agent is unavailable, substitute another Registrar-listed agent, with novation of the engagement letter and no Registry filing yet made.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Search Desk, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name availability search for [ENTITY_NAME] or the alternates proposed in the engagement; obtain the Registrar's written name-clearing notice; lodge a 30-day name reservation, if available, or accept a non-binding availability confirmation to proceed with execution of Articles. The chosen name must end with a corporate designator such as 'Corporation', 'Inc.' or 'Limited' and must not be identical or deceptively similar to a name already on the register.
required_dossiers: Name availability query form
Name reservation request (where applicable)
Consent letter of any existing name holder for similar names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the proposed name as identical or misleading, receive and revise the alternate list on the same query, then reserve the first available designation; no Articles are executed until the clearing notice is in hand.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, Notarisation and Agent Countersignature of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (pre-filing certification executed by the licensed Resident Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Incorporator signs the Articles of Incorporation containing the RMI BCA Section 105 requirements: corporate name, registered agent and registered office, authorised share classes, permitted purposes, incorporator details and initial directors; the signature is notarised, the Resident Agent countersigns the acceptance of the registered office, and the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation election statement is attached so that the entity is qualified for the tax-exempt zone treatment.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarised Articles of Incorporation (equivalent of Form BCA-1)
Consents of the initial directors under RMI BCA Section 146
Registered Agent acceptance and countersignature certificate
Corporate name clearing notice
Non-Resident exempt status election statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the examining officer queries the Articles for defect, file a written response with the Registrar within 15 business days and, if required, execute a certificate of correction or re-file amended Articles for endorsement before payment of the incorporation fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Articles and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registry Filing Window, Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (national corporate registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Resident Agent lodges the original Articles of Incorporation together with the fee transmittal and the official state filing fee remittance of US$450 for standard processing (3 business days), or elects expedited (1 business day) or same-day priority service if operationally required; the Registrar validates statutory compliance, stamps the record and issues the Certificate of Incorporation together with the assigned corporate registration number.
required_dossiers: Original Articles of Incorporation with notarisation and agent countersignature
Registrar fee transmittal form
Application for Certificate of Incorporation
Official state filing fee payment receipt (US$450 standard, plus priority surcharges where elected)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues an RFI or rejects the submission under RMI BCA Section 106, the agent cures the defect by filing a correcting certificate or a clean amended copy within the Registrar's query window and re-pays the minimal re-filing fee; any delay is mitigated by requesting an expedited re-submission slot.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Organisation, Corporate Governance Adoption and Exempt Status Perfecting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and licensed Resident Agent, with annual registrations acknowledged by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation and corporate kit, the Board adopts the Bylaws and passes the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering the share subscription, the registered office address, and the appointment of the President, Secretary and Treasurer; the directors and officers execute their consents; the Resident Agent confirms the registered office and service-of-process mandate; and the Registrar's annual compliance calendar (annual report and franchise tax) together with the Non-Resident exempt designation is docketed for filing each 31 March.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Board-adopted Bylaws
Pro-Forma First Board Resolution and officer/director acceptance forms
Registered Office and Registered Agent acknowledgement
Non-Resident exempt status statement and annual compliance calendar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry contests the governance records or exempt status election, re-file the certified resolution and registered agent acknowledgement as corrected records; filing of the annual franchise tax is cured within the 60-day late-reinstatement window before administrative dissolution is ordered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business License Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; separate environmental permitting arm: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General RMI Business License (Business License Act 2004) - not mandatorily triggered for a Non-Resident exempt data service; statutory financial-market or news-agency operating licence: Not Required for ISIC 6391 syndicated-news aggregation and API feed, which is a non-deposit, non-advisory low-risk information service.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands, established under the Environmental Protection Act 1987
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low Impact / Registration-Only Tier - a Full EIA Report is not required for a purely digital financial news aggregation operation; an EPA Registration / compliance notice applies only upon establishment of a physical office, standby generator, or any sewage discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with EPA Chapter 3 effluent standards (5-day BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 30 mg/L) for any on-site septic system; generation sets to run on ultra-low-sulphur diesel (≤ 15 ppm S) with verified combustion maintenance; solid waste segregated under EPA Chapter 4 rules; e-waste and electronic media to be surrendered to an EPA-registered recycler with transfer records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification through the Majuro Fire Service annual inspection of exit routes, portable extinguishers, and emergency lighting; structural load clearance from the Majuro Building Inspectorate for the registered office and server-equipment zone (minimum 50 psf design load); workplace registration under the RMI Social Security Administration and compliance with the Workplace Injury Insurance Act 1982 for all resident employees; civil defense coordination with the National Disaster Management Office for typhoon and emergency continuity planning.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Office (RTO), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; corporate registry administered by the Registrar of Corporations through licensed Registered Agents (Association of Registered Agents portal: www.register-iri.com).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No RMI income-tax TIN is issued to a Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC), as non-resident domestic corporations are statutorily exempt from national income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, franchise tax, and gross-receipts tax. The BC obtains a corporate registration number from the Registrar of Corporations and a Certificate of Good Standing. Ancillary registrations arise only on actual local nexus: employer registration with the RMI Social Security Administration (3% employer wage contribution) if RMI-based staff are engaged, and customs importer registration if physical goods are imported. A pure cross-border financial-newswire API exporter (ISIC 6391) with no RMI employees or imports requires no VAT/GST ID, no fiscal code, and no income tax filing; annual franchise report and fee compliance through the Registered Agent is the only recurring obligation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: RMI law provides no 'check-the-box' or hybrid-mismatch elections because no entity-level or pass-through income tax regime exists. Available statutory elections under the Business Corporations Act are limited to: (a) continuance/re-domiciliation of a foreign corporation into or out of the RMI; (b) election to waive the non-resident tax-exempt status and be treated as a resident corporation, thereby creating RMI-source taxable nexus; and (c) election between semi-annual and annual franchise reporting. The RMI has not adopted OECD BEPS hybrid mismatch rules; no GILTI, CFC, or subpart-F equivalence applies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/sales tax regime; the sole indirect levy is the Customs Import Duty and Green Tax under the Marshall Islands Customs and Excise Act 2000, applicable to physical imports only.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST registration threshold exists; the RMI imposes no indirect tax on services, and the syndicated-finance subscription/API revenue stream falls entirely outside the scope of the Customs Import Duty. Local currency is the US Dollar (USD); no turnover threshold is prescribed because no services-based indirect tax is levied.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — the RMI mandates no electronic invoicing, no real-time fiscal clearance, no API-based tax reporting, and no digital stamping. Commercial invoices are paper/PDF-based and regulated only by contractual practice; the RMI Customs Service requires conventional manifests solely for physical cargo clearance, with no software integration obligations for service exporters.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — the RMI operates no VAT/GST system, so no export zero-rating claim, input-credit mechanism, or refund procedure exists. Cross-border financial news and API data services supplied by a Non-Resident BC are categorically exempt as non-RMI-source income: no output tax is chargeable, no input tax is recoverable, and no zero-rating substantiation is required.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating clawback regime exists because no indirect tax is imposed on services. Residual scrutiny: the RTO may challenge whether a BC factually engaged in RMI-source activity (e.g., RMI payroll, local office, or on-island equipment) that would forfeit the non-resident exemption; misdeclaration to the RMI Customs Service triggers penalties and forfeiture under the Customs and Excise Act 2000; failure to maintain Registered Agent presence or annual franchise records causes loss of Good Standing, suspension of corporate rights under the Business Corporations Act, and a US$500 annual-report delinquency penalty. The RMI imposes no exchange-control or FX-repatriation sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The RMI maintains no national central bank; the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender, and monetary policy authority is exercised de facto by the U.S. Federal Reserve. Licensed deposit-taking institutions are regulated under the Banking Act 1989 and supervised by the Banking Commissioner.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de jure and de facto convertibility on both current and capital accounts. The RMI is formally dollarized: there is no domestic currency, no foreign exchange control law, and no approval mechanism for cross-border capital movements. Profit remittance hurdles: none — dividends, shareholder distributions, royalties, management fees, and liquidation proceeds may be remitted freely in USD by SWIFT MT103 without RMI government consent or withholding. Capital repatriation is unrestricted and does not trigger any RMI tax for the non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. The RMI prescribes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation for export, services, or subscription receipts. All trade receipts may be retained in any currency via any licensed bank, and no central bank confirmation, import/export declaration, or proceeds repatriation certificate is required for payments to or from the entity.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Current Account / Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam — RMI Branch (Majuro / Ebeye)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Corporate Account / Merchant Settlement Account
Development Deposit Account (not suitable for non-resident BC treasury)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: HIGH for USD subscription receivables and operating vendor payables through U.S.-licensed Electronic Money Institutions and payments platforms (e.g., Mercury, Wise Business, Stripe Treasury); MEDIUM-LOW for large syndicated finance wire traffic because offshore EMIs frequently deselect RMI-registered entities or impose enhanced UBO and corridor review. Legal constraints: RMI law does not prohibit the BC from holding offshore EMI accounts, and the RMI has no domestic EMI licensing regime. The RMI–U.S. FATCA Model 1 IGA requires the BC to self-certify as an active NFFE (Form W-8BEN-E) to avoid 30% U.S. withholding; correct NFFE classification and absence of U.S. payor flows keep RMI-side reporting obligations at nil.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory mandate requires directors to appear in person, but Banking Act 1989 Customer Due Diligence rules and correspondent-bank de-risking pressures effectively require at least one authorized signatory to complete a live video interview or an in-person activation visit. Bank of Marshall Islands is strictly document-driven and typically requests a physical or notarized board resolution, apostilled corporate records, and may require a Majuro visit for accounts with projected turnover above USD 10,000 per month. Bank of Guam permits remote onboarding with apostilled constitutional documents, certified director passports, notarized/medallion signature guarantees, and a documented video KYC interview. Fully remote opening without any interview is not commercially available for a non-resident, tax-exempt RMI Business Corporation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident, tax-exempt BC with no RMI office, staff, or economic substance — shell-company red flag
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered Agent certificate of incumbency; Certificate of Good Standing issued by the RMI Registrar; certified Certificate of Incorporation and Articles; organizational chart; UBO passports and residential utility evidence; source-of-wealth statement; executed commercial contracts (newswire API subscriptions, market-data licensing agreements); director board resolution appointing signatories; substance memorandum describing the offshore digital-intermediation operating model and the commercial rationale for RMI domicile.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ISIC 6391 financial newswire flagged as unlicensed financial services, investment advice, or market-manipulation data conduit
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI legal opinion confirming no statutory license is required for syndicated news aggregation and data-feed distribution; written product description limiting scope to aggregated market news and API data (no trade execution, no order routing, no personalized investment advice); upstream data license agreements (exchange feeds and news-wire contracts) and downstream API subscriber agreements; compliance policy firewall separating editorial content from client digital instructions; negative licensing confirmation from the RMI Banking Commissioner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdictional stigma: RMI corporate vehicles historically associated with offshore banking licenses and financial secrecy
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation status report; current Banking Commissioner licensing certificate; OFAC and global sanctions screening policy with audit trail; negative media/news search; reviewed or audited management accounts; detailed fund-flow diagram evidencing subscription income only and arm's-length operating expenses; engagement letters with a reputable RMI registered agent and an independent AML compliance consultant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity: nominee shareholders, bearer shares, or undisclosed controllers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full written UBO schedule (full legal name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, ownership percentage, and TIN); board confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding or, if any exist, that the physical certificates are immobilized with the registered agent; disclosure of any nominee arrangement naming the true principals; RMI beneficial ownership register extract maintained by the registered agent; executed ongoing-obligation letter for UBO updates within 14 days of any change.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All injections must arrive via SWIFT MT103 in USD from the named shareholder's bank account to the BC's designated operational or escrow account. Wire narrative must specify the purpose code (SWIFT category 'CAPC' — capital contribution, or clear text 'SHAREHOLDER CAPITAL INJECTION — MH_BC'); do not commingle third-party remittances. Verification protocol: remitter must match the registered shareholder; submission of remitter bank statement and certified resolution recording the share issuance; enhanced source-of-funds evidence for any single credit above USD 50,000 (salary records, investment liquidation statements, inheritance documents); OFAC and sanctions screening immediately prior to booking. No RMI exchange-control approval is required, and no withholding is applied to capital injections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 for vendor and licensor payments, data-feed royalty fees, director fees, and dividend distributions, executed against the bank's correspondent network (typically U.S. clearing banks). For large infrastructure procurement (data-centre capacity, terminal hardware, platform licences), irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit issued via SWIFT MT700 with a confirming U.S. or Asian bank may be used. Stripe — one of the entity's target rails — settles global subscriber receivables (USD, EUR, GBP) into the designated operational account. Wise Batch or ACH is acceptable for low-value recurring content-syndication fees to avoid correspondent deduction erosion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forwards on USD/EUR, USD/GBP, and USD/JPY with tenors up to 12 months, executed with licensed U.S., U.K., or Hong Kong counterparties under board-approved ISDA documentation
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted-convertibility currencies (e.g., CNY, NGN, ARS) where the RMI entity is the USD payor and the NDF is cash-settled in USD offshore
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR and USD/GBP) for structural alignment of syndication-fee liabilities with functional-currency inflows
Plain vanilla FX options (call/put on USD crosses) purchased pursuant to a written internal treasury policy and within board-approved notional limits

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Payment (corporate annual return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (e-filing portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary month rule - file during the calendar month containing the incorporation anniversary (e.g., a 15 March incorporation must file 1-31 March each year); no statutory extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: USD 200 late-filing penalty if submitted after the anniversary month; failure to file/pay for two consecutive years exposes the corporation to administrative dissolution/strike-off by the Registrar after notice, with assets escheating to the Republic

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is imposed on a private non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act; audit becomes compulsory only for (i) securities-listed issuers, (ii) licensed banks/insurance/trust licensees, or (iii) companies whose articles, bylaws, or syndicated finance loan covenants require audited financial statements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory GAAP is prescribed for tax-exempt non-resident BCs; IFRS and US GAAP are equally accepted market standards where financial statements are prepared for lenders or shareholders

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual return discloses only issued share capital, directors, officers, and registered office - it does not name UBOs. Per the Marshall Islands AML/CFT regime, the licensed registered agent must hold verified beneficial ownership records and refresh/re-confirm them at least annually and immediately upon any share transfer; failure to update the Register of Members and agent CDD file on transfers is a compliance breach

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 - no statutory audit; market estimate USD 5,000 - USD 15,000 if lender-covenant audit is triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% on worldwide income for non-resident Business Corporations
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption from RMI income tax, capital gains tax, gross receipts tax, dividend withholding tax, and value-added tax for domestic Business Corporations whose activities are conducted outside the Republic; the only annual state charge is the Business Corporations Act franchise tax assessed on authorized capital (minimum annual government fee regime).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Corporation Annual Statement (BOCA Section 78) filed with the Registrar of Corporations through the RMI Corporate Registry online portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Statutory payment and statement due date: January 1 following the filing year; a grace filing window extends to April 30; delinquency, surcharges, and interest accrue from May 1.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Statement Item 1 — Corporate Name, File Number, and Date of Incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered legal name, corporation file number, and certificate of incorporation date
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the name and file number exactly as shown on the certificate of incorporation; non-resident entities need not register or disclose any local trade name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Statement Item 2 — Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the registered office in the Republic and the name and address of the licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the licensed RMI registered agent's address is required as the statutory seat; a foreign principal office address may be stated as the corporation's principal place of business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and residential or care-of addresses of all directors and officers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident and foreign national directors are permitted; list each director with a care-of address in their home jurisdiction; no RMI work permit or residency is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Statement Item 4 — Authorized and Issued Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value per share (if any), and number of issued and outstanding shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report share figures matching the certificate of incorporation and any share registers; the annual franchise tax scale is applied by reference to the maximum authorized share count or capital stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Statement Item 5 — Business Purpose and Exemption Status Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of the corporation's stated purposes and confirmation of non-resident exempt status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the financial data aggregation, syndicated-finance newswire, and API content licensing mandate; declare that all commercial activities occur outside the Republic to preserve the 0% income tax position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Statement Item 6 — Declaration, Signature, and Agent Consent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of an authorized director or officer together with the registered agent's signed consent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Execution may be effected through the RMI registered agent; electronic signatures are accepted via the Corporate Registry online filing system; the signed original must be retained by the agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Demands not settled by April 30 incur a late surcharge of 10% on the unpaid franchise tax plus monthly interest of 1% per month (12% per annum) until discharged; continued non-filing exposes the corporation to administrative dissolution and strike-off by the Registrar, with resultant loss of the certificate of good standing and limited liability recognition.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions made by a Business Corporation to resident or non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: RMI maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement; because no domestic WHT is levied, no internal 'treaty relief' claim or tax reclaim procedure exists. To evidence the zero-rate/exempt position to foreign payors and foreign tax authorities, the corporation obtains from the RMI Registrar a Certificate of Residence, a Certificate of Good Standing, or a tax-exemption certificate confirming RMI tax-exempt residency; such certificate is issued without tax clearance or WHT reconciliation because no RMI tax liability accrues. The U.S.–RMI Compact of Free Association is not a double tax treaty and confers no WHT relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory RMI withholding tax on cross-border royalties and debt interest paid to non-residents is 0%; no reduced treaty rates apply because the RMI treaty network is effectively absent. Foreign-source withholding on the corporation's API syndication fees, content licensing royalties, or wire-based income must be analysed under the counterparty payor's domestic law, where the RMI exemption certificate may be used to support residency-based relief under local statutory provisions or the OECD Multilateral Instrument.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — RMI imposes no corporate income tax and maintains no statutory transfer pricing documentation regime; there is no local-currency threshold triggering Local File or Master File obligations in the Republic. OECD BEPS-aligned transfer pricing documentation may nonetheless be required by counterparty jurisdictions for cross-border API subscription, data licensing, or syndicated-fee arrangements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance Regulations apply to registered entities carrying on geographically mobile specified activities, including banking, financing and leasing, fund management, insurance, headquarters, shipping, intellectual-property holding, and distribution/service centres. A syndicated-finance newswire and API data aggregation business is presumptively not a specified activity where it merely disseminates data and receives subscription fees via Swift-wire and Stripe rails; it becomes subject to full economic substance requirements if it additionally extends credit, holds financial assets, acts as a financing intermediary, or conducts a licensable banking/finance activity. Non-specified entities remain bound by lighter expectations: maintenance of a registered agent, board minutes, accounting records, and an annual substance declaration in the Corporate Registry.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Claiming non-resident tax-exempt status while generating RMI-source income (e.g., through unlicensed RMI shipping, domestic insurance, or local credit intermediation), or knowingly filing a false annual statement concealing such activities and the true beneficial owners from the Registrar.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution and strike-off by the Registrar; fines of up to US$1,000 per offence under the Business Corporations Act for false statements; compulsory restitution of any avoided state franchise taxes; loss of limited liability recognition and nullification of the certificate of good standing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the corporation is used as an instrumentality, courts may pierce the corporate veil and render directors and officers jointly and severally liable for misrepresentations in the annual statement; directors are subject to disqualification orders and, in aggravated criminal cases, travel bans and custodial penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the syndicated-finance newswire entity with no employees, no physical premises, and no RMI substance while the entity in fact conducts a specified ESR activity (such as financing or leasing), and failing to file the annual substance declaration or to satisfy the directed-management-and-mind test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Financial penalties of US$10,000 for a first violation and US$50,000 for each subsequent month of continuing violation under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations; automatic reporting to the Competent Authority and exchange of information with foreign tax authorities; administrative strike-off and deregistration of the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers face personal enforcement of arrears, director disqualification orders, and potential civil restitution to the Competent Authority; repeated breaches may give rise to travel restrictions and, in cases involving deliberate concealment, imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach and Beneficial Ownership Concealment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the financial newswire API as a front for undisclosed beneficial ownership; accepting Swift-wire and Stripe settlement funds without customer due diligence, sanctions screening, suspicious transaction reporting, or beneficial-ownership registration, in contravention of the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism framework.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fines and imprisonment for money-laundering and terrorist-financing offences under the RMI MLTF regime; regulatory suspension or revocation of the registered agent licence; asset freezes and civil forfeiture; exposure to foreign correspondent-bank de-risking and exclusion from international payment rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are personally prosecutable; the High Court may order civil forfeiture, freezing orders, and travel bans pending investigation; flagrant predicate money-laundering conduct carries custodial sentences of up to 20 years in addition to restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Evolving the syndicated-finance newswire into deposit-taking, lending, payment processing, remittance, or brokerage services without obtaining the requisite RMI banking, financial-services, or money-transmitter licence, while marketing such services to third parties through the API and wire rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cease-and-desist orders and regulator-imposed fines; restitution to affected customers; criminal liability for carrying on regulated financial activity without a licence; administrative dissolution of the non-compliant entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for unauthorized deposit-taking and unlicensed financial conduct; courts may impose personal restitution obligations, director disqualification, travel bans, and imprisonment for aggravated violations.
